name: FormSurface
title: 3D texture painting with layers, baking and PBR export on your own machine
summary: FormSurface paints directly on 3D models with projection painting, fill layers, generators and baking, and exports PBR maps for game engines and renderers.
lede: FormSurface is a free, open-source 3D texture painter. The brush hits the mesh in world space and writes into the UV textures, so strokes keep a constant on-screen size and cross UV seams. Painting, compositing and the viewport run on the GPU in a Rust engine, and the finished maps export through templates for glTF, Unreal Engine, Unity, Godot, Blender and more.
runs_on: macOS, Windows and Linux, in a WebGPU browser or as a Tauri 2 desktop app
checks: Paints on the mesh in 3D and writes into UV textures, with occluded and back-facing surfaces protected.
Stacks paint, fill, filter and folder layers with masks, generators and 31 layer blend modes.
Bakes high-poly normal, ID, height, opacity, ambient occlusion and bent normal maps through a cage, in a background worker.
Exports separate PBR maps or engine templates as PNG, TIFF, OpenEXR, Radiance HDR, JPEG or PSD.
Lets Claude Code work on the open model through an MCP server with 68 formsurface_* tools.

facts.dd: glTF, GLB, OBJ, FBX, USD (USDA, USDC, USDZ), PLY and Collada
Rust and wgpu on WebGPU, with a TypeScript and Vite editor and a FastAPI service
A browser with WebGPU (Chrome, Edge, Safari 26, Firefox on Windows or macOS) or WebGL 2

chapters.title: Paint on the model, not on the flat texture
chapters.text: Projection painting writes strokes into the UV textures in world space, so they do not stretch on distorted islands. Brush, polygon fill, clone, path, text and a 2D UV view reach every face, and symmetry mirrors across axes or repeats radially.

chapters.title: A full texturing stack
chapters.text: Texture sets, UDIM tiles, fill layers with tri-planar, planar, spherical, cylindrical or warp mapping, masks with effect stacks, and generators such as cavity, edges, thickness and dirt. Intelligent materials and masks can be saved and shared as .fsasset.json files.

chapters.title: Bake from high poly, export for your engine
chapters.text: Bake from a high-poly mesh through a distance cage or a custom cage, then export with templates for glTF, Unreal Engine, Unity HDRP and URP, Godot 4, Blender, Arnold, Redshift, USD Preview Surface and Sketchfab, or build your own template in the Export panel.

features.title: 3D projection painting
features.text: The brush hits the mesh in world space and writes into the UV textures.
bullets: Strokes keep a constant on-screen size and cross UV seams
No stretching on distorted islands
Occluded and back-facing surfaces are protected
Camera, tangent wrap, tangent planar and UV alignments

features.title: GPU engine in Rust
features.text: wgpu running on WebGPU in the browser. Painting, compositing and the viewport never leave the GPU.
bullets: Nothing round-trips through the server while you paint
Seam padding (dilation) on the composited maps
Idle texture sets can be paged out of GPU memory
Desktop app with a frozen service as a sidecar

features.title: Channels
features.text: Base color, roughness, metallic and height, plus an extra channel per texture set.
bullets: Extra channel: a named user channel, opacity, ambient occlusion, emissive, transmission or scattering
Up to two further named grayscale user channels per set
Height is shown as bump and exported as a normal map
Each channel can be switched on or off per stroke and per fill

features.title: Brush and tools
features.text: A brush with size in screen or object space, hardness, flow, spacing and pen pressure, plus fill, clone, path and text tools.
bullets: Round, square and spray tips or any image as a brush alpha
Polygon fill, Lasso Fill and Rectangle Fill
Clone (C), Path (L) and Quick mask (T)
Text as a brush tip, a stencil or a fill layer image from TTF, OTF or WOFF fonts
Symmetry with up to eight copies, or radial

features.title: Layers, folders and masks
features.text: Paint, fill, filter and folder layers with masks and mask effect stacks.
bullets: 31 layer blend modes
Folders nested up to 16 deep with passthrough blending
Undo and redo (24 strokes)
Masks from a brush, an image, an ID map color or a generator that follows every bake
Fill layers by UV, tri-planar, planar, spherical, cylindrical or warp mapping

features.title: Texture sets and UDIM
features.text: One texture set per material, split per UDIM tile when UVs leave 0 to 1.
bullets: Set size from 256 to 4096 per set
Layers and folders can be instanced into other texture sets
Paint across texture sets with one undo
Mesh reload keeps layers, with optional reprojection onto the new surface

features.title: Baking and generators
features.text: High-poly baking in a background worker so painting continues.
bullets: Tangent-space normal, ID, height, opacity, ambient occlusion and bent normal maps
GPU baking of curvature, thickness, position and world normal from the mesh
Generators: cavity, edges, thickness, from top, light, position, 3D noise, dirt, metal edge wear
Filter layers: blur, sharpen, levels, hue, saturation and more

features.title: Intelligent materials and masks
features.text: Material stacks in an asset browser with thumbnails, search and filters.
bullets: Worn painted metal, rusty iron, dusty plastic and brushed gold built in
Your own saved stacks, shared as .fsasset.json
Eight intelligent mask presets
Any layer's generator setup can be saved to the library

features.title: Viewport and path tracer
features.text: PBR shading with choice of view transform, an HDR or studio sky and a progressive path tracer.
bullets: ACES, Standard, AgX, Filmic or OpenColorIO 2 configs
Working space linear Rec.709 or ACEScg
Up to 12 bounces, denoiser, depth of field, glass and subsurface scattering
Render to file up to 3840 by 3840 as PNG
Bloom, glare, lens flare, vignette, film grain and color correction

features.title: Export
features.text: Templates and custom templates, per texture set, at sizes from 512 to 8192 as the GPU allows.
bullets: PNG (8, 16-bit), TIFF (8, 16, 32-bit float), OpenEXR, Radiance HDR, JPEG and PSD
Padding by infinite dilation, dilation width, transparent, color or diffusion fill
File names with $mesh, $textureSet, $map, $udim, $u, $v and $size tags
Mesh as OBJ with UDIM UVs, optionally tessellated and displaced by height

features.title: Claude Code inside the app
features.text: A terminal dock, Claude Code and a chat pane run in the editor.
bullets: Terminal dock (Ctrl+J) with tabs, on a PTY in the service
Claude Code (Ctrl+Shift+J) already connected to the formsurface MCP server
Chat (Ctrl+Alt+J) with Markdown replies, tools run, memory and cost
Edit Layer in External App (Ctrl+Alt+E) round-trips a layer through Photoshop or another app

features.title: Agents, batch and scripting
features.text: An MCP server with 68 formsurface_* tools drives the open editor.
bullets: ./formsurface batch script.json runs tool calls, also headless
./formsurface script job.py runs Python with the formsurface_api package
A Python panel in the editor runs scripts through Pyodide
Press Agent link in the top bar to let agents in

features.title: Commands and languages
features.text: One command registry drives the menu bar, palette and shortcuts.
bullets: Command palette (Ctrl+K)
Edit > Keyboard Shortcuts rebinds any command
Interface in English and 25 more languages
The Form family's 28 themes, chosen in Preferences

parity.summary: Fifty capabilities documented for Substance 3D Painter 12.1.5. Revision 41 re-graded FormSurface 0.59.3 by tracing every row in its code: no grade moved and the five partial rows stay partial. docs/PARITY.md gives 47.5 of 50 (95 percent) at v0.56.3. ArmorPaint and Blender are the other two columns.

requirements: A browser with WebGPU or WebGL 2
docs.agents: An MCP server with 68 formsurface_* tools; Claude Code picks it up from .mcp.json, other clients run ./formsurface mcp over stdio.

topics.title: Controls
topics.text: Left drag paints, right drag or Alt + left drag orbits, the wheel zooms, and B, E, P, C, L and M pick paint, eraser, polygon fill, clone, path and mirror.

topics.title: Commands and shortcuts
topics.text: Every action is a command in one registry, run from the menu bar, the palette (Ctrl+K) or the keyboard, and Edit > Keyboard Shortcuts rebinds any of them.

topics.title: Export templates
topics.text: The Export panel lists templates for glTF, Unreal Engine, Unity, Godot 4, Blender and others, and builds your own with any source per R, G, B and A.

topics.title: Agents and scripting
topics.text: The README documents the MCP tools, ./formsurface batch for JSON scripts and ./formsurface script for the formsurface_api Python package.

topics.title: Desktop app
topics.text: ./build_app freezes the service with PyInstaller and packs it with Tauri 2: a macOS .app and .dmg, and a Linux .deb and AppImage.

topics.title: Parity
topics.text: docs/PARITY.md in the repository summarises how FormSurface covers 50 documented capabilities of the reference painter.

items: The desktop window's scripts keep their types on Windows, fixing a blank window
build_app takes --config and Linux builds the AppImage too
formsurface.bat gains a desktop build, and Windows installs stop on a failed step
Headless runs end the whole process tree on Windows
Window smoke test and CI job added
The fps readout is reserved so the status bar does not shift

shots_wanted.what: The 3D viewport with a painted model
shots_wanted.how: Run ./formsurface, open http://localhost:5176 in Chrome or Edge, pick a built-in sample such as the torus knot, then paint a few strokes with the left mouse button.

shots_wanted.what: The layer stack with a fill layer, a mask and a folder
shots_wanted.how: With a sample mesh loaded, open the Layers panel (Alt+2), add a fill layer with Ctrl+Shift+F and a folder with Ctrl+G, and add a generator mask.

shots_wanted.what: The Export panel with a template chosen
shots_wanted.how: Open the Export panel (Alt+5), choose a template such as glTF or Unreal Engine, and leave the file list visible before exporting.

shots_wanted.what: The 2D UV view beside the 3D view
shots_wanted.how: Press U with a mesh loaded to toggle the 2D view of the active texture set and paint a stroke into it.
